overview: Built an automated logistics control system for managing shipment booking, carrier selection, pickup coordination, live tracking, delivery exceptions, proof of delivery, and carrier performance.
The workflow takes a new shipment request and turns it into a complete logistics lifecycle, from carrier sourcing and dispatch to delivery confirmation and operational reporting.

list: Receives new shipment requests through webhooks or forms
Validates shipment, customer, route, cargo, and delivery information
Creates shipment records and dedicated Google Drive folders
Calculates routes, travel distance, and estimated transit time
Searches approved carriers based on service region, capacity, equipment, and compliance
Sends quotation requests to suitable carriers
Receives, normalizes, and compares carrier quotations
Calculates carrier scores using price, availability, reliability, damage rate, and on-time performance
Generates recommended carrier summaries using AI
Routes shipments for manager approval when required
Creates confirmed carrier bookings automatically
Generates shipping documents and sends required documents through DocuSign
Sends booking confirmations to carriers and customers
Monitors upcoming pickups and sends driver reminders
Processes pickup confirmations, delays, failed pickups, and shipment-not-ready conditions
Retrieves carrier tracking data and recalculates delivery ETA
Detects at-risk and critically delayed shipments
Sends customer ETA updates and operations alerts automatically
Creates structured exception records for delivery problems
Receives delivery confirmation, signatures, photos, and proof of delivery
Reconciles expected and delivered shipment quantities
Routes partial, damaged, or rejected deliveries to claims handling
Closes successfully delivered shipments
Generates final shipment summaries and sends POD documents to customers
Calculates carrier performance after each completed shipment
Performs weekly audits for late shipments, missing PODs, open exceptions, and claims
Updates logistics analytics in Google Sheets

blocks.p: The workflow uses predefined shipment, carrier, approval, delivery, and exception templates.

list: Carrier quote requests
Booking confirmations
Shipment documents
Customer status updates
Delivery exception alerts

blocks.p: This keeps logistics communication consistent across customers, carriers, shipments, and delivery stages.
Airtable or SmartSuite acts as the central shipment, carrier, exception, and delivery tracking system.

list: Shipment status
Selected carrier
Carrier score
Pickup status
Current ETA
Delivery risk
Exception status
POD status
Delivery result
Carrier performance

result: A complete automated logistics pipeline that turns a shipment request into an approved, booked, tracked, delivered, reconciled, and documented shipment without requiring operations teams to manually coordinate every step.
The system also keeps carrier quotations, pickup activity, live ETA, shipment exceptions, proof of delivery, claims, carrier performance, and logistics analytics organized in one workflow.
